Name: Rosy Cottage - Farmhouse replacement
Author: wabiii
Description:
[list]
[*][size=3]Replaces the farmhouse with a quaint brick cottage covered in roses[/size]
[*][size=3]There are various colours kindly provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/15599024]A[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/15599024]riasonata[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71424903?tab=about+me]Asterisk555[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]If you are using [b]CP[/b] you can change these with the generic config menu﻿﻿﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]If you are using [b]AT[/b], use the paint bucket from Robins on the farmhouse to reskin it! This allows you to use it alongside other building mods and I would highly recommend it![/size]
[/list]
[size=3]   This is my first building mod so beware that there are small inconsistencies in the artwork, if anything major looks off please let me know!
   This is only a farmhouse replacement so if you'd like to use another building mod alongside it please use the alternative textures version.
   There are currently only winter seasonal replacements but I plan to add some small details for spring/summer/fall later on. 

[b]   [u] ANY ERRORS OR BUGS MUST BE POSTED WITH A LOG OR I CANNOT HELP YOU[/u][/b]

[/size]
